steps.clue: Build the gallows beside the courthouse.
Shatter all four red orbs with a Turbine-powered Subsurface Resonator.
Knock down the floating lantern with a grenade.
Charge the lantern then place it on the rooftop symbol.
Decode the message and strike the three named tunnel signs.
Guide the wisp to the gallows, trigger the Time Bomb, then guide it there again.
Ring the nine bells as directed by the mansion switchboard.
Make a wish and complete the sharpshooter targets.
